title: Why do GPUs make AI fast?
topic: Why do GPUs make AI fast?

scenes.say: Why does AI run on GPUs... and not on a normal CPU?

visual.text: Why do GPUs make AI fast?

scenes.say: Because under the hood, AI is mostly one thing. Multiplying grids of numbers.

visual.caption: one layer of a neural network

scenes.say: And a big model does that billions of times, for every single word it writes.
A CPU has a few very fast cores. They work through the list, one step after another.

visual.caption: CPU: a few fast cores, in turn

scenes.say: A GPU has thousands of simpler cores. They all multiply at the same time.

visual.caption: GPU: thousands of cores, all at once

scenes.say: So when the grid gets bigger, the CPU slows right down. The GPU barely notices.

visual.caption: time to finish vs grid size

scenes.say: Same math. Just done in parallel. That's the whole secret.
